description: Replace text in a UI input selected by snapshot ref, selector, or coordinates. An empty text clears the field. Unconfirmed evidence does not establish the resulting value or screen. The recordAs option keeps sensitive text out of a recorded replay while sending it to the live app. To append instead of replacing, use type. Times out after 90s; a caller-supplied budget extends it.

device.description: Device name; ids go in udid or serial.

raw.description: Use raw snapshot data during selector resolution.

recordAs.description: When script recording is armed, send text to the live app but publish it as ${VAR}. Use an uppercase replay variable name such as PASSWORD.

ref.description: Snapshot element ref such as @e12. Pass exactly one of ref, selector, or x+y.

scope.description: Snapshot scope selector used before resolution.

selector.description: Selector expression such as id="submit" or label="Sign in". Pass exactly one of ref, selector, or x+y.

serial.description: Android, HarmonyOS, or Vega VVD serial.

settle.description: Once the UI goes quiet, return the diff vs the pre-action tree. Best-effort; never fails the action.

settleQuietMs.description: Settle: quiet window in ms (default 500, 300 on iOS simulator; broad iOS screen swaps hold at least 1500).

text.description: Text to enter into the target. Pass "" to clear it.

verify.description: Capture cheap post-action evidence (AX digest, node counts, changedFromBefore) instead of a follow-up snapshot.

x.description: Screen x coordinate, with y. Pass exactly one of ref, selector, or x+y; use x+y only when no ref or selector is available.

y.description: Screen y coordinate, with x. Pass exactly one of ref, selector, or x+y.

name: fill
title: Replace text in a UI input
